name: search_schools
description: Search US colleges and universities by name. Returns school name, location, tuition, admission rate, student size, median earnings, and completion rate. Example: search_schools("MIT", "MA").

query.description: School name to search for (e.g., "Stanford", "community college")

limit.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100)

name: get_school
description: Get detailed info for a specific college by its College Scorecard ID. Returns tuition, admission rate, student size, median earnings after 10 years, completion rate, and median debt.

id.description: College Scorecard school ID (numeric, from search results)
